name: Edscha Automotive Michigan
old_description: Edscha has been producing in the lower Bavarian town of Hengersberg since 1963. This is our biggest location in Germany. On a production area of around 30,000 square meters we manufacture mainly hinge systems, brake pedals, handbrakes and electric drives for liftgates. Hengersberg possesses considerable manufacturing expertise and a high level of automation in production.
about:
Edscha Automotive Michigan operates from Auburn Hills, Michigan, as part of the global Edscha group that traces its origins to 1905. The Michigan site employs approximately 130 people and functions within a network of 25 locations worldwide that supply nearly all major automobile manufacturers.

The company produces automotive body components including hinge systems for doors, hoods, and liftgates, as well as brake pedals, handbrakes, and electric drives for liftgates. Manufacturing processes involve machining, forging, cutting, and stamping of sectional and strip steel, with a noted focus on energy efficiency in the machining of hinges and mounting retainers.

Edscha serves the automotive industry broadly, providing components to almost all automobile manufacturers globally. The Michigan location supports this customer base as part of the group's North American footprint.

Edscha positions itself as a strategic development partner to the international automobile industry, emphasizing innovation in articulation and retention systems for vehicle bodies.
